text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Haa... haa...! Hehe...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: (Ah... running is so much fun...!)

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Phew~...

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text: Fine Motiooon! That was an amazing run!!

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Watching her run looking so happy like 
that... I couldn't take my eyes off 
her...!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Seriously, this year... it's totally gonna 
be Fine Motion, right?!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
A-Also, I just realized...! Is it really 
okay to drop the honorifics!?

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, I see! Which means... "Lady"? Lady 
Fine Motion?!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Everyone! No need for honorifics, you can 
talk to me casually!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Thank you for your cheers♪ Fufu...

text_block_list.name: Trembling Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Fine-chan...!

text_block_list.name: Trembling Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry about... earlier. I just got 
scared of running...

text_block_list.name: Trembling Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Still, caught up in your running... I 
actually had a little fun. I'll do my best 
so I can feel that way again...!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Yeah. I'm rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I'm baaack~. Today was quite delightful as 
well♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion is smiling. Yet, for some 
reason, something felt off about her 
smile.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Oh? And what do you mean by that?
choice_data_list:
As long as nothing's wrong, that's fine, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I've thought about it a little, sure. But 
it's really nothing major at all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was just thinking how everyone's running 
for all sorts of different reasons~

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I know it's a bit late to bring this up! 
Running isn't the only goal for everyone.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Especially this Classic race—for some 
girls, it's their entire goal... their 
absolute dream.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
"Still, I'm different. I had another 
mission from the very start, after all..."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Hmm. I'd like to think that's not quite 
it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I think that's incredibly rude. I earned 
the right to be here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
So it's not so much that I feel 
inadequate... it's complicated.
choice_data_list:
You have your own circumstances to 
consider too.

I know you have your own circumstances to 
consider.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I know that, I get it, okay~? So can we 
just drop this already—
choice_data_list:
It's totally fine if just running is your 
dream.

It's totally fine if just running is your 
dream, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, that's true. Running will surely... 
always be my dream.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
...Whew, that really took me by surprise 
though. Guess I'm way more selfish than I 
thought!

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
I was actually quite serious about wanting 
everyone to do their best for my sake. I 
feel like I've discovered a whole new side 
of myself!
choice_data_list: I bet it's just pure instinct.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The desire to compete with all one's 
might— that is likely something we are 
born with as Umamusume."

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Instinct...

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: That is hardly a welcome thing.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: "...Nope! I'm gonna go get changed!"

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: —Oh? It's still so bright outside.
choice_data_list: Summer will be here in no time.

Summer will be here before we know it, 
huh?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Ehh~, for real!?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Speaking of summer, there's the 
training camp, right?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tracen Academy holds a training camp every 
summer, a season when Umamusume tend to 
grow the most.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Going on a trip and staying overnight with 
everyone! I'm really looking forward to 
it.

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text: Of course, for training too, right?

text_block_list.name: Fine Motion
text_block_list.text:
Once we get past that, it's the final leg 
of the Triple Tiara... the Shuka Sho, huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fine Motion fixed her gaze ahead. It 
seemed as though her eyes were already 
envisioning her next target race... the 
Shuka Sho.
